original_target.title: A single critical activity for the continuum Widom–Rowlinson model
original_target.area: Probability, continuum statistical mechanics, and phase transitions

scope_comparison: Section 3.2.1 of Dereudre–Houdebert explicitly says the single-threshold symmetric diagonal is unresolved; the sharp theorem fixes beta and varies z. Jahnel–Kamecke Corollary2.2 proves coexistence at sufficiently large activity, not a single transition on z=beta=lambda. Random-field lattice results have a different space and disorder. No new full diagonal uniqueness/nonuniqueness theorem was located.

primary_sources.locator: Section3.2.1, Proposition3.2, following conjecture; section3.2.2 explicitly disclaims resolving it
